== Build notes (2026-10-16) ==
Minted as a sibling Star Wars card game page (Young Jedi / SWTCG model). Product detail kept to set names and dates from official product pages. Gameplay sentence cites Wikipedia because the official how-to-play page is a JavaScript app that does not yield rules text to an HTML fetch. melee.gg standings are JS-rendered; the cited snapshot is the POST JSON from Profile/GetResults/dillen (handle matches Timo Dusel's GEMP handle).
